case_info.description: Branched arch, 70 % coarctation area reduction, pulsatile, Windkessel outlets
case_info.source: OpenCardioFlow gallery; mesh and numerics from cases_input/ubend/config_adaptive_span.json

transport_properties._comment: Standard blood: rho=1060 kg/m³, mu=0.004 Pa·s → nu=3.77e-6 m²/s

numerics._comment_max_co: max_co 0.5 and two non-orthogonal correctors (20 Nov 2026): with 0.8 and one corrector the 0 % case blew up at the inlet at t = 0.2246 s (first deceleration) on a 71-degree cell; the G3 runs used 0.8 / 1.

geometry._comment: Blender geometry in mm, scale 0.001 to meters. outlet1=descending, outlet2-4=branches

windkessel_settings._comment_betaN: betaN 1.0 clamps the normal velocity on backflow faces (inletOutlet-like). With betaN 0 the middle branch of G3 ran away when its flow reversed in late systole (20 Nov 2026 gallery run).
